description: This class includes the manufacture of articles made of fur skins.
includes: manufacture of fur apparel and clothing accessories
manufacture of articles of apparel made of artificial fur
manufacture of plates, crosses and similar forms of fur skins
manufacture of fur skin articles: rugs, poufs
excludes: production of raw fur skins, see 0140, 0150
dressing and dyeing of fur, see 1511
manufacture of imitation furs (knitted or woven pile fabrics), see 1391, 1312
